subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Red Flags of a Pyramid
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Red Flags of a Pyramid.

hook.text: Most pyramid schemes share the same warning signs. Learning them can save your savings.

buildup.text: High-pressure recruitment, upfront fees, and income claims with no proof are classic flags.

discovery.text: If the company makes more money from recruits than from actual customers, it's a pyramid.

twist.text: Modern schemes disguise fees as 'starter kits' and recruitment as 'team building.'

climax.text: The simplest test: could this business survive if nobody recruited another member?

punchline.text: If recruiting stops and the business dies, it was never a business.

quiz.question: What is the simplest test for a pyramid scheme?
options: Check if the product is good
Ask if the business survives without recruiting
